items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: At that time, I mean, I read Mark Twain, but I didn’t understand it.

ctx.x: Who were you reading that might have had an impact?
At that time, I mean, I read Mark Twain, but I didn’t understand it. I was a kid.
Are we talking about seventh grade, or are we talking about younger now?
